purpose: Declares the machines required for raw-development platform qualification (spec P5/A11/A12) and the workloads each available machine must execute. Fail-closed: every machine listed here must eventually carry executed, passing results; machines that do not exist stay explicitly unavailable and keep the platform release gate blocked. CI workflow definitions are not execution and never satisfy this manifest.

provisionalTargets.note: Spec A12 provisional target: warm 1536-pixel preview response p95 below 150 ms. Measured misses are release blockers; final budgets are agreed only after the first measured slice, never by silently redefining this number.

hardware.notes: Development host; the only machine with executed raw-development GPU evidence so far (baseline capture 2026-09-26/27, slice qualification 2026-09-27).

gpu.notes: Adapter name recorded from wgpu; observed backends for offscreen rendering on this host are Dx12 and Vulkan.

machines.reason: No Linux reference machine exists in this development environment. Linux (Vulkan) wgpu qualification is explicitly UNTESTED; this remains a release blocker (spec P5). A CI runner definition, if one existed, would not count as executed evidence.

No macOS reference machine exists in this development environment. macOS (Metal) wgpu qualification is explicitly UNTESTED; this remains a release blocker (spec P5). A CI runner definition, if one existed, would not count as executed evidence.
